typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFilePath as string (),
	AuthFileName as string (),
	AuthOBFileName as string (),
	AuthRecCount as integer (),
	AuthTermFileName as string (),
	AuthTermRecCount as integer (),
	ConfFileName as string (),
	ConfOBFileName as string (),
	ConfOBQuery as string (),
	ConfRecCount as integer (),
	ConfTermFileName as string (),
	ConfTermRecCount as integer (),
	InboundFileLocation as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	ResRecCount as integer (),
	ResTermRecCount as integer (),
	RestFileName as string (),
	RestOBFileName as string (),
	RestOBQuery as string (),
	RestTermFileName as string (),
	RUNID as string (),
	Server as string (),
	ToFolder as string (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		D_DOB as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM as string,
		D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_1 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_2 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_3 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_CITY as string,
		C_STATE as string,
		C_ZIP as string,
		C_COUNTRY as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME as string,
		T_PHONE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK as string,
		T_PHONE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL as string,
		T_PHONE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INTL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INTL as string,
		T_PHONE_INTL as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INTL as string,
		T_PASSWORD as string,
		T_PASS_HINT as string,
		F_NOTES as string,
		MEM_EMAIL as string,
		End as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(RunID = toDouble($RUNID),
		FileType = toString(trim('CONF')),
		D_DOB = iif(isNull(D_DOB) || length(trim(D_DOB)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM = iif(isNull(D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM) || length(trim(D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM = iif(isNull(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM) || length(trim(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM)) == 0, toTimestamp(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toTimestamp(toString((substring(toString(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM = iif((greaterOrEqual(D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM,toTimestamp(toString('2099-12-31', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'))), toTimestamp(toString('2099-12-31', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM)) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RunID as double,
		FileType as string,
		D_DOB as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM as timestamp 'ect.format.datetime.hypen.4year2month2day2hour24mmnute2secondsdot6nanoseconds',
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_1 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_2 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_3 as string,
		T_ADDRESS_CITY as string,
		C_STATE as string,
		C_ZIP as string,
		C_COUNTRY as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME as string,
		T_PHONE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK as string,
		T_PHONE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL as string,
		T_PHONE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INTL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INTL as string,
		T_PHONE_INTL as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INTL as string,
		T_PASSWORD as string,
		T_PASS_HINT as string,
		F_NOTES as string,
		MEM_EMAIL as string,
		End as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		D_CANCEL_CONFCOMM,
		RunID,
		FileType,
		D_DOB,
		D_EFFECT_CONFCOMM,
		N_FIRST,
		N_MID_INIT,
		N_LAST,
		N_SUFFIX,
		I_SSN,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER,
		F_EMPLOYEE,
		C_PREFIX,
		I_CONTRACT,
		I_HCID,
		C_INDIV_REL,
		C_ANT_ENT,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_1,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_2,
		T_ADDRESS_LINE_3,
		T_ADDRESS_CITY,
		C_STATE,
		C_ZIP,
		C_COUNTRY,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME,
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME,
		T_PHONE_HOME,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK,
		T_PHONE_WORK,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL,
		T_PHONE_CELL,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INTL,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INTL,
		T_PHONE_INTL,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INTL,
		T_PASSWORD,
		T_PASS_HINT,
		F_NOTES,
		MEM_EMAIL,
		End)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
